name: Pearl
look: a large pearl-white swan with faint aqua tinting along the edges of its feathers, a long graceful neck and calm dark eyes
temperament: Serene and protective; it glides beside her and hisses at anything that threatens her patients
scenePlacement: gliding beside her on shallow water, its wings half raised
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
